extracted.intended_audience: state agencies and members of the public who submit, track, or review Texas rulemaking notices (agency staff, regulated parties, attorneys, and interested citizens)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and descriptive standards for publishing and accessing rulemaking notices and related documents in the Texas Register (the weekly journal of Texas state agency rulemaking). Covers what is published, formats, archives, posting deadlines, and content responsibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Texas Register publication scope
rubrics_metrics.description: A weekly publication, the Texas Register serves as the journal of state agency rulemaking for Texas. Information published in the Texas Register includes proposed, adopted, withdrawn, and emergency rule actions, notices of state agency review of agency rules, governor's appointments, attorney general opinions, and miscellaneous documents such as requests for proposals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: After adoption, these rulemaking actions are codified into the Texas Administrative Code. Issues are posted to the website no later than 5 p.m. on the publication day.

rubrics_metrics.name: Issue posting deadline
rubrics_metrics.description: Issues are posted to the website no later than 5 p.m. on the publication day.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Current Issue (May 8, 2026) is available in HTML and PDF; previous issues are also available in HTML and PDF. RSS feeds are provided for updates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Types of materials accepted/published
rubrics_metrics.description: Information published includes proposed, adopted, withdrawn, and emergency rule actions; notices of state agency review of agency rules; governor's appointments; attorney general opinions; and miscellaneous documents such as requests for proposals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These categories define the kinds of documents a submitter should expect to have published in the Texas Register; contact information for the submitting entity is included in each posted document.

rubrics_metrics.name: Archival coverage and searchability
rubrics_metrics.description: Search the Texas Register (includes January 28, 2000 - current issues). University of North Texas Libraries Back Issue Archive is available.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Search and archive resources allow users to find current and historical notices; subscription services and RSS feeds provide update options.

rubrics_metrics.name: Content responsibility and accuracy disclaimer
rubrics_metrics.description: The Secretary of State is not responsible for the information or content that is contained in Texas Register notices. Nor does the SOS make any representations as to sufficiency or accuracy of the posted information.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Postings contained in the Texas Register are submitted electronically by parties outside the control of the SOS and any questions about a particular posting should be directed to that entity. Contact information is included in each posted document.

rubrics_metrics.name: Post-publication codification
rubrics_metrics.description: After adoption, these rulemaking actions are codified into the Texas Administrative Code.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Adopted rules appearing in the Texas Register are later incorporated into the Texas Administrative Code (TAC); the Register therefore functions as the publication vehicle prior to codification.
